entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Delhi Sultanate, a political institution in Afghanistan during Ghaznavid and Ghurid Empires (1148–1215). Grew from Al-Biruni writes Kitab al-Hind, a systematic study of Indian civilization and Mahmud of Ghazni raids the Somnath temple, one of seventeen campaigns into India. Led to the emergence of Ghurid Dynasty and Delhi Sultanate Origins and Ghurid.
